notes.title: Release Soundtrack
notes.notes:
Good afternoon! There were many who wanted to get the soundtrack from our game Mike was Cursed, and now you can do it. We are happy that the music is like the game you liked, so we would be happy if you supported us by buying a soundtrack for a symbolic sum! Go to the Steam store to find out more!
Your Raum Studio!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 + Support ot the Russian Language
notes.notes:
The Update 1.0.1:
- Support of the Russian language has been added
- The bag with computer in the end of the game has been fixed
- The opportunity of changing the level of the game (chapter) has been added 
- The music in menu has been added
